text:
Sasha (PM): Quick sync — we need engineering signoff on the changelog link + docs staging and a final rollout cadence for the public announce next Tue 10:00 PT. Cant move without the PR link and canary window.
Alex (Marketing): Ok noted. Blog post target 10:05 PT (short post + benchmarks). Webinar is scheduled Wed 16:00 PT, will open registration after the announce. Will we have embargoed screenshots/assets?
Jordan (Engineering): @Sasha I opened the changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/456 — contains the bullet notes and breaking/compat sections. Please review.
Paul (Docs): Docs staging is up: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/release-2026 - includes API examples and migration notes. Still need one more code sample from runtime team (kv-cache snippet).
Sasha (PM): Thanks. Can you confirm canary timing and fallback plan? Marketing needs the canary end time to publish the post after it's healthy.
Jordan (Engineering): Canary plan: 1h initial canary in us-west, 2% traffic, health checks every 30s. If no errors >5m, expand to 20% for 30m, then full. Rollout script (ops):
```
# rollout cadence
start: 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z  # canary start
phase1: 2% for 60m
phase2: 20% for 30m
full: 100% if green
fallback: rollback to v1.14 and alert #eng-oncall
```
Jordan (Engineering): Target latency SLOs unchanged. If we see token error spikes during phase1 we'll abort.
Maya (Growth): For inbound routing — can we tag the first wave leads as "announce-2026-c1" so SDRs can prioritize?
Alex (Marketing): Yes please. We'll wire the GA + UTM and include a short benchmark snapshot in the post. Do you have the final benchmark numbers we can quote?
Jordan (Engineering): Final perf numbers land in the infra report, short summary: median gen latency 160ms @ 8k tokens/min workload (quantized profile). I'll paste the exact two-line stat before EOD.
Paul (Docs): One more ask: update the docs header with the migration note and link the changelog PR. I'll merge once @Jordan confirms the sample.
Sasha (PM): Ok checklist:
- [ ] Changelog PR merged (Jordan) -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/456
- [ ] Docs staging have final sample (Paul + Jordan) -> https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/release-2026
- [ ] Canary window confirmed (Jordan) -> starts 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z
- [ ] Marketing assets (screenshots, bench snapshot) delivered (Alex)
- [ ] Lead-routing tag (Maya) -> announce-2026-c1
If all green we'll publish blog at 10:05 PT, enable social, and flip the press embargo at 10:00 PT.
Alex (Marketing): I'll prepare the release post and schedule social. Will need final screenshot + bench stat by 18:00 PT today.
Jordan (Engineering): I'll post the bench snippet here by 18:00 PT. Also pinging @ReleaseBot to start the preflight check at T-1h.
ReleaseBot: Preflight checks queued. Running: changelog link reachable, docs staging reachable, canary infra health checks OK (pending deploy).
Sasha (PM): Great — please react with :white_check_mark: once your item is done so we can close this thread.
Alex (Marketing): Got it.
Paul (Docs): On it.
Jordan (Engineering): Will update PR and paste bench numbers by 17:55 PT.
Maya (Growth): Tagging note added to campaign board.
Sasha (PM): Thanks team — will reconvene in the 30m preflight if anything pops up.
